purpose: Index materially distinct historical curriculum bodies and preserve direct working-tree snapshots for side-by-side comparison and future reuse.
canonical_rule: Historical existence does not create publication authority, but historical curriculum must remain retrievable verbatim.

hard_gates.before_material_rewrite: Create or verify a verbatim working-tree snapshot of the prior body and register it here before replacing the current representation.
hard_gates.before_route_retirement: Create or verify a verbatim working-tree snapshot of the route/body being retired and register it here.
hard_gates.before_classification_removal: Preserve the exact source text even when the proposed classification is DEFER_OR_REMOVE.
hard_gates.before_branch_or_tag_prune: Owner must explicitly approve the specific prune only after every unique curriculum body on that ref has a registered verbatim working-tree mirror.
hard_gates.archive_mutation: Never silently edit an archived verbatim body. New corrections create a new version.

scope: complete courses/ trees at every live source branch tip
complete scripts/ trees at every live source branch tip
complete visuals/ trees at every live source branch tip
every distinct selected path + blob version found across all commits reachable from the 48 source branches and fetched tags
materialized_snapshot_sets.completeness_boundary: Complete for the selected course/content paths in Git objects reachable from the live branch and fetched-tag frontier at capture time. It does not claim preservation of unreachable/dangling Git objects that are no longer referenced by any fetched ref.

snapshot_records.note: Exact predecessor preserved before PR #95 replaces the public Advanced catalog/purchase-preview presentation.

snapshot_record_schema.note: Use individual snapshot_records for future targeted captures. The 2026-09-06 exhaustive set uses its own per-file snapshot and history manifests rather than duplicating thousands of records here.

mirror_completion_rule: A curriculum identity is considered mirrored for the 2026-09-06 frontier when its registered route and source-data history are represented by the exhaustive snapshot set. Future materially distinct versions must be added as new snapshots before destructive replacement. Source refs remain protected even after mirroring unless the owner separately authorizes a specific prune.
current_state: PR #48 planning/retrieval architecture remains accepted. The 2026-09-06 exhaustive archive supplies the initial historical retrieval surface; targeted post-frontier materially distinct bodies, including the pre-PR #95 Advanced presentation, are registered in snapshot_records before replacement. No archive entry authorizes curriculum deletion, branch pruning, or restoration as current content.
